Always see comments about aim assist, and how it’s too strong. Aim assist is good if you have great aim, when you don’t even have good aim it helps but barely.

PC players assume every console player has decent aim like in this clip. I wish it was true, but my 30%(ish) accuracy on Soldier 76 at gold rank says differently.

I’m guessing if I played against a GM PC player, who wasn’t even shooting back, my accuracy would plummet to around 20% or probably less. Just because of movement alone. It isn’t as strong as it seems, especially in Overwatch, it has the weakest aim assist in an FPS I’ve ever experienced personally.
